subject: Customer request: written assurance on training usage & retention
messages:
From: Jamie Turner <jamie.turner@acmefin.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acmefin.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Data usage question for procurement - do you train on customer data?

Hi Rishi,

We are finalizing procurement paperwork and have two questions that must be addressed in writing by our vendor security team:

1) Do you use customer data (including prompts, completions, embeddings, telemetry) to train or update your public or private models? If yes, what opt-in controls exist?
2) What are the default retention periods for customer inputs, output tokens, logs, and KV cache? Is there a documented deletion/expunge process we can reference?

I've attached our standard vendor questionnaire and highlighted the sections we need explicitly answered. Legal will likely ask for a short attestation we "do not train on customer data" unless there is clear opt-in language.

Could you send a succinct written response we can include with the contract? If necessary, we can route through procurement and e-signature.

Thanks,
Jamie Turner
Director, Platform Security
Acme Financial
[Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Turner <jamie.turner@acmefin.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Data usage question for procurement - do you train on customer data?

Hi Jamie — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. High level answer below; I'm copying our security and legal leads to provide the detailed, auditable statements you need.

Short answer (for procurement): Redwood does not use customer-provided production data to train or improve our public models by default. Customers can opt-in to programmatic telemetry or explicit training programs, and those require documented consent and an opt-in flow.

Retention overview (defaults):
- API inputs/outputs: retained for up to 30 days by default for debugging and abuse detection, then purged.
- Request logs/metrics: aggregated metrics retained longer (up to 365 days) but not storing raw textual inputs.
- KV cache/prefix caches: ephemeral in memory; persistent caches are governed by customer config and retention settings.

We can provide: a short attestation letter, SOC2 excerpt, and our DPA clause language. See attached short product security summary; security will follow-up with the deletion/playbook and opt-in mechanics.

Would you prefer a single signed attestation or separate security + legal artifacts? Happy to do either.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-product-security-summary.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Turner <jamie.turner@acmefin.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Data usage question for procurement - do you train on customer data? (technical detail)

Hi Jamie — adding the technical detail you can include in the vendor packet. I'm pasting the key points; please let me know if you need a formal appendix on letterhead.

-- Technical assurance (concise) --
1) Training/use of customer data:
- Hosted API: Customer inputs are NOT ingested into model training pipelines by default. We segregate telemetry used for system health/abuse detection from any training datasets. Any use of customer data for model updates requires a documented opt-in and explicit contract language.
- Dedicated & Private deployments: Data remains in tenant scope. Private (VPC/on-prem) customers retain full control; no data is sent to Redwood's training pipelines.

2) Retention and deletion specifics:
- Default retention windows: API request/response artifacts 30 days; aggregated telemetry up to 365 days. Customers can shorten the window via the Console (Settings -> Data Retention) or API.
- Immediate deletion: For accounts requesting deletion, we support account-level purge plus log obfuscation; full expunge is run within 7 business days for production artifacts and up to 30 days for backups depending on the snapshot cadence.
- KV / in-memory caches: ephemeral and not included in persistent backups unless customer explicitly enables persistence.

3) Proof & controls:
- We can provide: DPA excerpt, deletion playbook, SOC 2 report redacted, and a per-account deletion audit log exported as CSV.
- Auditability: Deletion actions generate traceable events (job ids, timestamps). We maintain the audit trail but redact content in retained backups by default.

4) Opt-in telemetry/training programs:
- Any program that would use customer content for model improvement is opt-in only, requires legal approval, and is accompanied by a roll-back/withdrawal clause.

Attachments: data-deletion-playbook.docx (step-by-step for procurement)

If acceptable, I can convert this into a short attestation and hand it to Legal for signature.

— Priyom
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: data-deletion-playbook.docx (DOCX)]
